Refactored the single-file implementation into a small, testable Java codebase.

What changed:
- Split the algorithm, edge model, and union-find into separate files:
  - [KruskalMST.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/KruskalMST.java)
  - [Edge.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/Edge.java)
  - [DisjointSet.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/DisjointSet.java)
- Kept both input styles:
  - `kruskalsMST(int, int[][])`
  - `kruskalsMST(int, Edge[])`
- Added explicit validation for:
  - negative vertex counts
  - null or malformed edges
  - out-of-range vertex ids
- Added a lightweight regression harness in [KruskalMSTTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/KruskalMSTTest.java)

Verification:
